subject: AtlasBank RFP — Vulnerability Management Evidence and Pen Test Summary
messages:
From: Janet Cole <j.cole@atlasbank.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@atlasbank.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: AtlasBank RFP — vulnerability management evidence request

Markus —

Thanks for the quick intro call today. AtlasBank's security review team is compiling evidence for the procurement packet (RFP ATB-2026-RFP-089). We need a consolidated set of artifacts addressing your vulnerability management program so we can clear Redwood for the next round. Specifically we need: 

- Executive summary of the most recent external penetration test (high-level findings, mitigations, residual risk; redacted as needed)
- Current SBOM export for the primary inference runtime and control plane components
- SAST/DAST snapshot results for the last 90 days (high severity counts + remediation status)
- Patch SLA matrix: expected timelines for critical/important/medium patches and historical compliance metrics for the last 12 months
- Notes on SOC2/ISO evidence intersections if relevant (we can map items)

Can you provide these by EOD Friday (Dec 3)? If you need to stagger delivery, let me know the earliest deliverable (we'd prioritize the pen test exec summary and patch SLA matrix). Also include any redaction guidance for internal findings.

Thanks — Janet

Janet Cole
Head of Security Evaluations, AtlasBank
janet.cole@atlasbank.com

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: AtlasBank RFP — vulnerability management evidence request

Team — forwarding AtlasBank's ask. Deadline EOD Friday (Dec 3). Let's split deliverables and coordinate redaction:

- Laura: can you pull the executive pen test summary and the redacted findings? They want a high-level exec summary + mitigation status. If we need to mask IPs or customer identifiers, follow the usual redaction checklist.
- Marissa: can you export the SBOM for the inference runtime & control plane, plus the patch SLA matrix and the SAST/DAST snapshots (90-day)? We should include counts of high/critical findings and remediation ETA where tracked.

Proposed delivery plan:
1) Thu EOD: internal draft of exec pen test summary + patch SLA matrix (for internal review)
2) Fri AM: SBOM CSV + SAST/DAST snapshots (redacted where required)
3) Fri by 2pm PT: consolidated zip we send to AtlasBank + link to secure drive for large files

Also: please populate the quick evidence index spreadsheet (I've attached template) with file names, run dates, and brief descriptions so Janet can consume quickly.

Thanks — Mark

Markus Klein
Director, Security & Compliance (on the platform team)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_index_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: AtlasBank RFP — vulnerability management evidence request

Markus / Marissa —

Attached: first-pass materials. Notes below.

Attachments (internal stamps):
- pen_test_exec_summary_2026-11.pdf (pdf) — executive summary, scope, key findings (all PII and client identifiers redacted per policy). Includes a one-page risk posture statement and mitigation timeline.
- daST-report-redacted.txt (txt) — redacted DAST findings for the public web interfaces; high-level counts and mitigation status (no PoC data).
- sast_snapshot_2026-11.html (html) — SAST summary with severity buckets and current open ticket counts (links to Jira omitted).

Key callouts:
- Pen test: overall medium residual risk; two findings classified as critical in test environment but already mitigated in prod; mitigation evidence attached as changelog excerpts (redacted).
- SAST/DAST: no active critical severity in production services; 3 high severity findings in staging (tracked, ETA to close: 14 business days).
- Redaction: we've removed all IPs, customer hostnames, and internal Jira links. If AtlasBank requires less redaction, we should coordinate via an NDA amendment.

I'll stand by for the patch SLA matrix from Marissa and will incorporate any language changes before sending externally.

—Laura

Laura Bennett
Security Response Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pen_test_exec_summary_2026-11.pdf (pdf)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Janet Cole <j.cole@atlasbank.com>, procurement@atlasbank.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: RE: AtlasBank RFP — vulnerability management evidence request

Janet —

Thank you for the request and the quick timeline. Please find our consolidated package attached and a secure delivery link below. Attachments have been reviewed and redacted per our standard disclosure policy; if you need additional detail for an internal audit we can provide a controlled session with our security operations team.

Package highlights (attachments):
- pen_test_exec_summary_2026-11.pdf — high-level executive summary, scope, top findings, and mitigation status.
- sbom_export_20261202.csv — component inventory for inference runtime + control plane (CSV).
- patch_sla_matrix_2026Q4.xlsx — SLA commitments and 12-month compliance metrics (critical/important/medium).
- sast_snapshot_2026-11.html — SAST snapshot (summary view).
- daST-report-redacted.txt — DAST redacted summary (no PoCs).

Secure download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bAtlas-RFP-evidence
Delivery notes / redaction: As noted by Laura, we've redacted customer-identifying artifacts and PoCs. If AtlasBank requires raw PoC details for an internal risk committee, we request a scoped NDA amendment + secure review session.

Next steps:
- If this looks sufficient, reply with confirmation and we'll mark the evidence step complete for the RFP.
- We can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough next week with our SOC lead to talk through remediation timelines and telemetry if you'd like (I propose Tue 12/7 or Wed 12/8).

Regards —

Markus Klein
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: [pen_test_exec_summary_2026-11.pdf (pdf), sbom_export_20261202.csv (csv), patch_sla_matrix_2026Q4.xlsx (xlsx), sast_snapshot_2026-11.html (html), daST-report-redacted.txt (txt)]
